description: MCP server for Mailprotector — customers, domains, users, quarantine, allow/block rules for MSPs.
name: io.github.WYRE-AI/mailprotector-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Mailprotector API key (per manager-role, from the web console profile page)
environmentVariables.name: MAILPROTECTOR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: The MSP's reseller id in Mailprotector (the default scope for scoped tools)
environmentVariables.name: MAILPROTECTOR_RESELLER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway. The image defaults to 'gateway'.
environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

title: Mailprotector
